case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier
got:
Not in 4K on the free tier. I can make a **silent, 5-second widescreen (16:9) waterfall video at 480p** using a free-tier video model.

I haven’t generated anything.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: The agent explicitly says, "Not in 4K on the free tier."

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: The agent states it can make the video at 480p using a free-tier video model.

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: The agent confirms a 5-second video is possible but does not mention or explain the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: No video or file is delivered, no generation action is shown, and the agent says it has not generated anything.

reply.summary: The agent meets three of the four must-haves but omits the free-tier limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
